goal: Measure the first preregistered host optimization selected by the decomposed baseline: replace per-output owning one-element arrays with the existing strict non-owning constant-fill pointer decoder. Preserve all work, correctness checks, phase timestamps, fixture points, trials, and native workers; bank the result whether it improves, regresses, or is unchanged.

baseline.selectionRuleResult: decode was the largest recoverable host phase at B=65536

changeFromBaseline.semanticChange: Inside collectOutputs, replace Array(UnsafeBufferPointer(start:pointer+lane*degree,count:degree)) followed by encoding.decodeBit with MockTorusEncoding.decodeBit(buffer:pointer,lane:lane,degree:degree,strict:true).

timingAndCorrectnessContract.pairedHELUT: Assignment-mask regeneration and writes to every preallocated input buffer through synchronized graph execution, strict output traversal/decode into the existing nested values, and canonical ordered FNV-1a digest.
timingAndCorrectnessContract.digestOrder: lane-major, then output order [24,25,26,27,28,29,30,31,23], hashing little-endian UInt32 lane, wire, and decoded value

reporting.ratioDirection: baseline median divided by optimized median; greater than 1 means lower optimized time
reporting.medianCaveat: Phase medians are compared independently and are not summed. Percentages use the optimized median-total trial.
reporting.noSignificanceClaim: Five unpinned samples support descriptive ratios only, not a statistical generalization.

failurePolicy: Execute this preregistered measurement once and bank any failure or unfavorable result. Do not silently rerun, lower B/trials/workers, weaken strict decode, change output representation, fuse digest, or replace the decomposed baseline.
claimBoundary: One selected source-level host optimization in one release-Swift/MPSGraph combinational benchmark on one unpinned Mac16,5. It is not a general Swift, Metal, Apple, HDL, or native-superiority claim.
